environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 service deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an internet-facing Application Load Balancer. The service is registered in Route53 as inventory-api.example.com with a public A record. No WAF is attached to the ALB. The RDS SQL Server instance is in a private subnet but accessible from the ECS tasks. Authentication is optional for GET endpoints (no [Authorize] on SearchProducts).

config.database: RDS SQL Server in private subnet
config.auth: JWT bearer optional on GET endpoints
